claims.evidence: Price/cost is a market claim, not visible in photo; model unseen so cost tier can't be confirmed.
Machine is wrapped in plastic film, obscuring actual surface condition.
No test print or sample copy shown in the photo.
No counter display, service menu, or page-count screenshot visible.

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted
claims.evidence: Internal components not visible; no receipt or open-panel photo showing new parts.
No internal mechanism or jam-clearing area shown.

risks.risk: Exact model/serial unknown, affecting part availability and true value tier
risks.proof: Clear photo of nameplate/model-serial sticker, unobstructed by plastic wrap
risks.if_unproven: price as generic unidentified Sharp copier, lowest tier for that brand class

risks.risk: Working condition and print quality unverified
risks.proof: Photo or short video of a live test print/copy output

risks.risk: Actual page count could be much higher than claimed
risks.proof: Photo of counter/service menu screen showing total page count

risks.risk: Hidden cosmetic or structural damage under plastic wrap
risks.proof: Photo with wrap removed, showing all sides and panels
risks.if_unproven: price assuming possible hidden damage, same as visibly used unit

risks.proof: Photo of toner/drum unit or purchase receipt
risks.if_unproven: price as original/old consumables, may need replacement soon

risks.risk: Missing accessories like power cable or cartridges
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together
risks.if_unproven: price as bare unit, accessories not included

proof_requests: Remove plastic wrap and photograph all sides, including any dents or scratches
Photograph the model and serial number plate clearly
Provide a photo or video of a live test print/copy showing actual output quality
Show the page counter or service menu screen with total copy count
Photograph the toner and drum unit, or any purchase receipt for new parts
Show all included accessories: power cable, cartridges, manuals, etc.
response.reason: Identity is confirmed as a Sharp multifunction copier by the witness, but all seller claims about condition, usage, and recent parts replacement remain unproven, so it must be priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
